notes: XT245 is the "Standard I/O" member of BrightSign's XT5 series (siblings: XT1145 "Expanded I/O", XT2145 "Expanded Multiplex I/O"). Unlike its siblings, the XT245 has no HDMI input, no USB-A/USB-C, and no serial port — confirmed explicitly in both BrightSign's hardware docs and the official XT5 datasheet. Audio out is a combo 3.5mm jack supporting analog and SPDIF digital simultaneously; modeled here as trs-3.5 (closest listed id — SPDIF-over-3.5mm has no dedicated id in the allowed connector list). GPIO is a 12-pin Phoenix/terminal-block connector (8 bi-directional GPIOs), modeled as euroblock. IR in/out is a 3.5mm jack, modeled with connector id "ir". Locking power input is a proprietary locking 12V/3A DC connector, modeled as dc-barrel (closest standard id; physically a locking barrel-style DC inlet, not a generic unlocked barrel jack). Internal-only interfaces (M.2 PCIe for NVMe SSD, M.2 E-key for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module, 2x Wi-Fi antenna connectors) and non-signal control buttons (SVC, Reset) and status LEDs were omitted as they are not external cabling I/O. Device is a compact desktop/wall-mount unit (238.62 x 185.90 x 19.19 mm) with built-in wall mounting, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.
